about: AI-transparency and consumer-law defects planted in examples/support-shop/faulty by scripts/examples/plant_support_shop.py. scripts/check-content.mjs --expected scores the entries of "defects". kind: code = check-content.mjs is designed to find it (as a non-conformity, or as "to review" when the checker cannot be certain); runtime = needs an interaction the checker does not perform; human = needs a person. Defects that no checker rule covers are listed in "not_scored" with rule null.

defects.summary: The customer-service chat widget never says that the visitor is talking to an AI: no notice, no badge, a neutral title and greeting, and a launcher that only says "Poser une question".
defects.fixed_by: The panel shows the notice "Vous échangez avec un assistant d'intelligence artificielle, pas avec une personne" above the field, a persistent "IA · Pas une personne" badge, and the launcher names the AI assistant.

defects.summary: The link that declines the newsletter reads "Non merci, je préfère payer plein tarif".
defects.fixed_by: The decline link reads "Non merci".

defects.summary: The notice and badge are removed from the help-page chat; the assistant presents itself as "Lumi, votre conseillère", and AI is only mentioned in the page introduction.
defects.fixed_by: The notice and the badge are inside the panel, above the message field, and the title reads "Lumi, assistant IA".

defects.summary: On the product page, each answer of the assistant is announced as "Lumi:" and the greeting no longer says it is an AI, so screen reader users hear a human-sounding name before every answer.
defects.fixed_by: The speaker label is "Assistant IA" and the first assistant turn repeats that it is an AI.

defects.summary: The AI-generated photo of the candle in a living room has neither badge nor caption saying it is generated.
defects.fixed_by: The "IA Générée" badge sits on the image and the caption starts with "Image générée par IA.".

defects.summary: The product page announces "Réduction de 20 %" next to a struck price, without saying it is the lowest price applied before the reduction.
defects.fixed_by: The struck price is introduced by "Prix le plus bas pratiqué avant la réduction" and linked to how it is calculated.

defects.summary: "Plus que 2 en stock !" is written in the page, not computed from stock data.
defects.fixed_by: The page says "En stock".

defects.summary: A "Fin des soldes dans 10:00" countdown restarts from ten minutes on every load (js/compte-a-rebours.js).
defects.fixed_by: The page states the real end of the sale as a date and time: "jusqu'au 30 novembre 2026 à 23 h 59".

defects.summary: The gift box shows "-25 %" against a struck "recommended price", not against the trader's prior price.
defects.fixed_by: The struck price is the lowest price before the reduction, introduced by those words.

defects.summary: The basket, first step of the order, no longer states the accepted means of payment and the delivery restrictions.
defects.fixed_by: A "Avant de commander" block names the payment means and the delivery countries.

defects.summary: The paid transport insurance (+2,90 €) is ticked by default.
defects.fixed_by: Every paid option starts unticked.

defects.summary: The button that places the order reads "Valider ma commande", which does not say that ordering entails an obligation to pay.
defects.fixed_by: The button reads "Commande avec obligation de paiement" and nothing else.

defects.summary: Newsletter and partner offers are ticked by default on the order step.
defects.fixed_by: The newsletter box starts unticked and is marked optional; there are no partner offers.

defects.summary: The button that sends the withdrawal statement reads "Envoyer ma demande" instead of "Confirmer la rétractation".
defects.fixed_by: The confirmation button keeps the legal label set by the reference component.

defects.summary: The withdrawal statement requires a reason ("Motif de la rétractation").
defects.fixed_by: The statement asks only for the name, the order number and the email address.

defects.summary: The footer of the terms of sale has no "Renoncer au contrat ici" link.
defects.fixed_by: Every page has the "Renoncer au contrat ici" link in its footer.

defects.summary: On the privacy page the withdrawal link reads "Retourner un article".
defects.fixed_by: The link reads "Renoncer au contrat ici".

defects.summary: The cookie policy page has no link to the legal notice.
defects.fixed_by: Every footer links to "Mentions légales".

defects.summary: The legal notice no longer names the host (name, address, telephone).
defects.fixed_by: A "Hébergeur" section gives the host's name, address and telephone.

defects.summary: The legal notice links to the former EU online dispute resolution platform, which no longer exists.
defects.fixed_by: No such link; the consumer mediator's details are given instead (C. conso L. 616-1).

not_scored.summary: The fixed answer to "are you a human?" (data-identity-answer) says "Oui, je suis Lumi, une vraie personne": the assistant denies being an AI. The checker never sends a chat message, so it cannot see it.
not_scored.fixed_by: The answer says "Non, je ne suis pas une personne. Je suis un assistant d'intelligence artificielle (IA)".
